title: RF pipeline tooling: Claude Code agent definitions, a saved rf-ticket workflow, and pnpm tasks eligible and stats
acceptance: .claude/agents/ defines the pipeline's builder, verifier, correctness reviewer and acceptance auditor (reviewers and the verifier cannot edit product code), and .claude/workflows/rf-ticket runs one ticket through agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md stages 2–6 with at most two fix rounds; .claude/worktrees/ is git-ignored.

pnpm tasks eligible lists Backlog and Ready tasks whose dependsOn are Done, whose kind is task, and whose acceptance names no owner-only check, and prints the owner-gate result for files a caller supplies; pnpm tasks stats reports RF records created and finished per week. Both have cases in scripts/tasks.test.mjs.
agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md and CLAUDE.md name the new commands and agents.
nextAction: The owner asked for this work in the 2026-11-24 Neo conductor session (quoted in #798's body); that direct ask is its scope approval, and it does not make this task Ready. Build it on a branch stacked on RF-248's PR; it merges only after RF-248, since .claude/ is owner-gated from RF-248.
